note: rhythm/position rules JSON Schema cannot express. Every rule id here is implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py (GRAPH_RULES_IMPLEMENTED); extraction/verify_all.py fails if the two sets differ. Each rule was checked against all 71 rendered reference pages when written.

rules.rule: the PageSpec node sequence (section#variant) must match its declared template's node pattern (required/optional/slots/sequence alternatives/repeat counts).
a template with status 'pending' has no contracts yet and cannot be generated against. No template is pending today: all 18 (T0-T17) are implemented in the clone (src/App.jsx registers T1-T17).

a page opens with its chrome variant's head nodes and closes with its tail: full = shell.announcement-bar, shell.navbar, shell.mega-menu, shell.mobile-drawer ... shell.footer; event = shell.event-subnav ... shell.event-footer; none = shell.minimal-nav and no footer. The only node allowed between the last content node and the footer is the overlay cta.dev-path-dialog.

a template's chrome variant (full | event | none) equals the chrome of every route mapped to it (routes/routes.json), and the page uses only that variant's shell nodes. The two non-full routes are pinned in code (/summit event, /partner-directory none) and verify_all compares them with src/Layout.jsx.

a PageSpec's theme equals its template's theme: light everywhere except the event microsite (T16), whose scoped palette, fonts and radius 0 form the `event` theme (tokens/themes/event.json). The champions dark bands are section surfaces of the light theme, not a theme.
at most one HERO-category node per page, and exactly one unless the template is a named exception.
rules.exceptionNote: these templates open with a page-specific header classified LISTING / ARTICLE / FORM / LEGAL / PRICING / DIRECTORY, not HERO (listing.header, article.story-header, article.guide-header, form.form-header, legal.policy-header, pricing.plan-cards, directory.header; blog posts and /terms-of-use open straight into their body). Pinned in code (HEROLESS_TEMPLATES).

rules.rule: when the page has a HERO node it is the first non-SHELL node.

a section may not appear more often than its contract's constraints.maxPerPage (observed maxima above 1: community.icon-cards 2, comparison.compare-table 5, content.media-split 4, cta.closing-band 2, features.card-grid 8, features.checklist 4, features.gradient-panel 4, interactive.faq-accordion 2, listing.press-grid 2).

no two adjacent nodes share the same (section, variant) unless that variant is listed in the contract's constraints.consecutiveVariants (the repeats the clone really renders: stacked bordered card grids, stacked text-left splits, the five self-hosting comparison tables, the integrations directory's logo-card grids, the two pricing FAQs, ...). Keyed on the pair, so alternating variants are always valid.
the last non-SHELL node should be CTA-category (true on most reference pages; listing, article-by-guide, form, legal, pricing, directory and the integrations/assistant pages end otherwise).
at most 2 nodes with autoplaying motion (carousel.autoplay, marquee.loop, marquee.photo-loop) per page (the homepage has exactly 2).

a node whose contract is retrievalEligible:false (pinned in code: announcement bar, mega-menu, mobile drawer, developer-path dialog, reading progress bar, category/search bar) may not be marked retrievalEligible:true, and a content node may not be marked ineligible.
cta.dev-path-dialog appears iff some action on the page has opensDialog:true (a hero button that opens the dialog), and then it is the last node before the footer.
template T0 is only valid on route '/', and route '/' only on T0.
in reference mode the route must be one of the template's mapped routes (routes/routes.json).
